King's Indian.name: King's Indian

moves.explanation: White opens with the Queen's pawn, grabbing central space.
Black develops the knight toward the center.
White expands on the queenside, often transposing to various Indian defenses.
Black prepares a fianchetto; typical King's Indian structure.

King's Indian.description: A hypermodern defense where Black allows White centre and plans a counterattack.

Caro-Kann.name: Caro-Kann

moves.explanation: King's pawn opening; classical central thrust.
The Caro-Kann's signature move, preparing d5 and solid structure.
White supports the pawn on e4 and occupies the center.
Black challenges the center directly; typical Caro-Kann pawn structure.

Caro-Kann.description: A solid, resilient defense; emphasizes structure and counterplay.
